description: Election Commission - Declare that T. Gunasinghe was Selected as the member of the Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections category.
